executiveSummary:
Coast has become the central platform for translating technical complexity into business value across product, sales, and marketing teams. The storytelling capabilities enable non-technical stakeholders to create compelling API-driven narratives without engineering bottlenecks, directly contributing to significant influenced pipeline growth.

Key adoption drivers: backend workflow visualization, interactive product storytelling, and self-serve demo environments show strong performance scores. Multiple core teams actively leverage Coast for developer docs, sales engineering, partner integrations, customer success, and product marketing.

Strategic value extends beyond immediate ROI - Coast is becoming the "translation layer" between engineering depth and GTM accessibility, enabling parallel technical + business narratives that resonate with both developer and executive buyers.

Recommendation: Expand to regional sales teams and product lines. Invest in Enterprise tier for advanced analytics, white-label capabilities, and dedicated technical account management.
